features.text: LOW LOAD PROLONGED STRETCH: Air bladder system delivers gentle, adjustable tension to treat severe elbow contractures.
AIR THERAPY CONTROL: Inflatable chambers allow precise stretch intensity for safe, progressive recovery.
ROM HINGES: Provide clinician-directed motion control for structured therapy and rehabilitation.
UNIVERSAL DESIGN: Fits left or right arm for flexible clinical use.
SOFT PADDED INTERIOR: Enhances comfort during extended wear for muscle re-education and recovery.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Adaptive tissue shortening and joint stiffness
Loss of range of motion following trauma or surgery
Muscle tone management requiring low-load prolonged stretch (LLPS) therapy
Rehabilitation following neurological injury or prolonged immobilization
